snippet.title: "Turn Around, It's a Trap!" — Homeless Girl Saved 28 Bikers, What They Did Next Left Her in Tears
snippet.description:
She had no phone, no address and no ID. All she had was a notebook full of license plates—and the nerve to stand in front of 28 motorcycles.

Josie Avery aged out of foster care with a garbage bag and a bus ticket. For fourteen months she has lived in a trailer under the Old Ferry Bridge. One Sunday morning she runs out of the pines and stands in the middle of the road as a whole motorcycle club rides down the hill to honor Eli, killed in a hit-and-run eight months ago. "Stop! Turn around—it's a trap!" The curve is greased with oil, the railing has no bolts, a man with a rifle waits across the river, and someone sits in a boat under the bridge so nobody makes it out of the water.

The club's leader, Pop, is the only witness at tomorrow's trial. The bikers catch the road crew red-handed. Then a county deputy rolls down the hill, calls the bikers an armed gang, and looks the homeless girl up and down: no address, no ID, oil on her shoes. He opens the back door of his patrol car. She rides with him and they all go home—or everybody goes to jail, and Pop misses court.

👉 Watch till the end — the girl nobody ever bothered to ask is about to show a whole town what she wrote down.

If you love stories where the person everyone overlooks turns out to be the only one who was paying attention, subscribe for a new story every week.

This is a fictional story made for entertainment. All characters, places and events are invented.

#BikerStory #HomelessGirl #Story

snippet.title: DEATH STRANDING ISOLATIONS | Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
DEATH STRANDING ISOLATIONS, the upcoming animated series streaming exclusively on Disney+ or other Disney Services in 2027.

STORY SYNOPSIS:

“My mom became a crater.”

The Death Stranding—a catastrophic series of explosions caused when the dead crept into our world and collided with the living.

In the wake of this cataclysm, many were forced to live in absolute isolation—among them, a young girl. Although this lonely existence was forced upon her, she soon grows to prefer solitude, eschewing all opportunities for real human connection and allowing herself to be strung along by fate.

In DEATH STRANDING, legendary game creator Hideo Kojima brought you a haunting vision of a shattered world. Now, that world expands into new frontiers with a brand-new animation series.

Under the guidance of director Takayuki Sano, world-class hand-drawn animations have been brought to life by renowned studio “E&H production” (NINJA KAMUI, BULLET/BULLET, the Magic Knight Rayearth television series).

The story is set in North America immediately after Sam—the protagonist of the game—reconnects the continent by means of the Chiral Network. However, as America is reborn from the ashes, the renewed connections that bind it together bring about new and unforeseen consequences.

In this tumultuous new landscape, there are some who walk a different path to the one chosen by Sam and his Bridges comrades: a wise old man who connects people through a method that defies all reckoning; a female soldier ensnared in a cycle of war and destruction; a boy who seethes with rage at the absurdity of his life...and of course, the girl who chose to sever all ties with the outside world...Fate has other plans for her, however, and chance encounters see her launched headfirst into a world she does not recognize.

snippet.title: Skye Newman - Survival (Official Audio)
snippet.description:
Skye Newman - Survival (Official Audio)

Listen to 'Survival' Out Now: https://SkyeNewman.lnk.to/SurvivalAY 
Listen to ‘SE9’ Out Now: https://SkyeNewman.lnk.to/SE9AY 

— — — 

Follow Skye Newman:

https://www.skyenewman.com/
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@skyenewman__
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/skyenewman__

— — — 

Lyrics:

Fought for food on the table,
When my mother wasn’t able,
I was scared to have a friend round,
Cause the noise it was so loud,

Take a look into my mind,
There’s so much sorrow that I hide,
A punchbag for this shit called life,
Yes I’ve

Been living in survival,
Still fighting when my eyes close,
Every day could be my final,
Cause I'm looking back on miles,
Of trauma and pain,
Poverty and rain,
It’s fight or flight through another day,
My instincts are so primal the hunger is so vital,
I face my inner child,
How'd you think I survived,

My body stopped me breathing,
Cause the stress I was receiving,
Attacked me with such panic,
Left me feeling manic,

Cause I was ashamed,
Of the house I was raised,
So young with such hate,
Just myself left to blame,
All of your problems,
Wasn’t mine to soften,
Fuck having to toughen,

Take a look into my mind,
There’s so much sorrow that I hide,
A punchbag for this shit called life,
Yes I’ve,

Been living in survival,
Still fighting when my eyes close,
Every day could be my finale,
Cause im looking back on miles,
Of trauma and pain,
Poverty and rain,
It’s fight or flight through another day,
My instincts are so primal the hunger is so vital,
I faced my inner child

How'd you think I survived 
How'd you think I survived
How'd you think I survived
How'd you think I survived

All of your problems,
Wasn’t mine to soften,
Fuck having to toughen,
When it should of been loving,

Been living in survival,

Primal,
Vital,
Trial,
Mind all

#SkyeNewman #Survival #SE9

In Episode 1, we kick things off by meeting up with Grian, gathering resources, and running into Mumbo! Before long, we form an alliance known as THE COOL GUYS! What could possibly go wrong? Well....Falling in an avalanche, dying to a creeper, and visiting the Shadow People's realm.

It's time for a brand-new season of chaos, questionable friendships, and survival. I hope you enjoy the first episode of Final Life, and I'll see you in Episode 2!

snippet.title: Wardruna - Helvegen II (Official Music Video)
snippet.description:
For some years now, we have been quietly working on a new recorded version of Helvegen. Not to replace the original, but to reflect what the song has gradually become. Helvegen has continued to evolve. More than any other song we have written, it has taken on a life of its own. 

Released alongside this new recording is a new music film directed by longtime Wardruna collaborator Tuukka Koski and filmed on location in Iceland. Together, the recording and film reflect what Helvegen has gradually become through more than a decade of performances and the countless lives in which it has found a place. 

Listen to Helvegen II: https://bfan.link/helvegen-II

If this new recording offers anything beyond itself, it is to encourage a renewed relationship with song, not only as something we perform or listen to, but as something that can accompany us through life. 

A tradition does not truly survive when it is merely remembered, but when it is lived.

Versuri

Intro (Theo Rose):

Iartă-mă, mamă,
Iartă-mă, tată,
Că v-am lăsat în urma mea,
Ca să devin eu cineva.
Îmi e rușine c-am fost plin de mine,
Mi-e frică și să mă gândesc
Cât timp mai am să vă iubesc…
E mult prea greu

Strofa 1 (Cabron):

La 10 ani eram copilul plin de visuri,
Visasem că fac muzică cu zero compromisuri.
Nu mi-a lipsit nimic, chiar dacă era greu,
Pe vremea aia, ai mei chinuindu-se pentru binele meu.
Le-aș mulțumi în fiecare zi c-au fost,
M-au sprijinit și-n zilele când am fost jos,
Și-n zilele când am fost prost,
Că nu-i mereu frumos, însă chiar și atunci mi-au făcut viața roz.
La 20, după ce m-am gândit în taină,
Uite-mă, mamă, astăzi sunt gata să plec spre faimă.
Știi, cred c-o să ne vedem mai rar
Și știu că asta pentru tine e cel mai mare coșmar.
Tata-i departe, dar e la mine cu gândul,
Să fac eu ce n-a putut să facă el, ar fi mândru.
Știu milimetric cum tre' s-o duc mai departe,
Drumul spre necunoscut și ai mei în spate.

Refren (Theo Rose):

Iartă-mă, mamă,
Iartă-mă, tată,
Că v-am lăsat în urma mea,
Ca să devin eu cineva.
Îmi e rușine c-am fost plin de mine,
Mi-e frică și să mă gândesc
Cât timp mai am să vă iubesc...
E mult prea greu.

Strofa 2 (Cabron):

Astăzi e ziua mea, fac 30 de ani,
M-au sunat ai mei să-mi spună „La mulți ani!”,
Da' aveam treabă.
I-am sunat înapoi în grabă,
Da' cred că semnalu' nu m-a lăsat să pot să îmi pornesc bine anu'.
Și am uitat să mai revin, bineînțeles,
Prins în atâtea nimicuri, să-l ia naiba de succes!
În care m-am băgat trăind periculos
Și de-aia mai mult îmi țin telefonul pe silențios.
La 35 am zis: „Gata!”
Acum chiar mi-am atins scopul,
Întorc banii cu lopata.
Ce-or mai face ai mei, mătușa, unchiu', strada?
Primesc un telefon și aud că se stinsese tata.
Avem atât de multă treabă (Avem atât de multă treabă)
Și totul pare important (Și totul pare important)
Ai tăi de-acasă te așteaptă (Ai tăi de-acasă te așteaptă)
Chiar dacă tu i-ai mai uitat.

Refren (Theo Rose):

Iartă-mă, mamă,
Iartă-mă, tată,
Că v-am lăsat în urma mea,
Ca să devin eu cineva.
Îmi e rușine c-am fost plin de mine,
Mi-e frică și să mă gândesc
Cât timp mai am să vă iubesc...
E mult prea greu.

snippet.title: Mariah Carey - Loverboy (4K Official Music Video) ft. Cameo
snippet.description:
Mariah Carey - Loverboy (4K Official Music Video) ft. Cameo

Watch the official music video for Mariah Carey’s “Loverboy,” featuring Cameo, restored in true 4K from the original 35mm film for Glitter’s 25th anniversary.﻿

﻿For the first time since its original release in 2001, the video is available in digital format and on streaming platforms.

Directed by David LaChapelle and filmed at LA County Raceway in California, the 2001 video brings Mariah and Cameo together in a world of fast cars and playful glamour. Built around Cameo’s “Candy,” the song features new vocals recorded by the group for Mariah’s version.

Written by Mariah Carey, Larry Blackmon and Thomas Jenkins

snippet.title: AZURA – I Feel My Heart Again (Original Mix)
snippet.description:
"I feel my heart again" by azura is an emotional afro deep house journey about reconnecting with the feelings you thought you had lost.
deep afro rhythms, warm rolling basslines, atmospheric melodies, and soulful vocals create a powerful sense of awakening. a sound that captures the moment when the silence fades, the walls come down, and your heart finally begins to feel again.

Some feelings never truly disappear. sometimes, all it takes is a rhythm to bring them back.

Close your eyes. follow the music. feel your heart again.

#AZURA #IFeelMyHeartAgain #AfroDeepHouse #AfroHouse #DeepHouse #EmotionalHouse #MelodicHouse

Muzică Crestina cu Biji din Barbulesti - VEDE DUMNEZEU
#VEDEDUMNEZEU #BIJIDINBARBULESTI #MUZICACRESTINA 

" Intr-o zi am auzit cateva cuvinte care spuneau asa : " VEDE DUMNEZEU SI E DE-AJUNS ", in acel moment mi-a sarit in minte ideea de a compune o cantare pe aceasta temă, m-am pus si am scris, si repede tot refrenul a curs si l-am terminat. Intr-o seara eram la spital cu Baiatul Eden, si stan la spital mi-am adus aminte de aceste cuvinte, si stand acolo, mia venit linia melodica. Dumnezeu vede totul, orice lucru neinsemnat de noi, in ochii Lui este Gol si Descoperit. El vede necazurile noastre, lipsurile, luptele, nedreptatile, acuzatiile, totul vede El. Nu uita niciodata VEDE DUMNEZEU. "

Muzică : Biji
✍🏻 Versuri : Biji/Rafael Mihai
📹 Video: Mario Vrg

snippet.description:
Welcome to Sunnybrook, an idyllic community where residents come to escape. Play as a burglar breaking into affluent homes when something prehistoric descends on the unwary residents. Sneak, steal, and survive as you escape a community turned hunting ground that gives new meaning to "eat the rich". Thank you to Breaking Dimensions for the game key!

Follow Me Here:
➜ http://instagram.com/thefoosterchannel 
➜ Twitter/X: https://twitter.com/thafooster

ABOUT WELCOME TO SUNNYBROOK:
Welcome to Sunnybrook.
Nestled in the rolling hills of the countryside, Sunnybrook is an exclusive seasonal community where wealthy families come to escape the city, enjoy their second homes, and leave their troubles behind.
As a burglar, you've arrived to take advantage of some of the empty homes and their absent owners. Pick locks, crawl through windows, crack safes, disable security systems, and take whatever you can carry. That is, of course, until prehistoric creatures suddenly appear to stalk the streets of the unsuspecting community. 
As Sunnybrook falls into chaos, the homes, streets, school, and businesses of this idyllic retreat become a hunting ground. As chaos descends around you, you're suddenly less concerned with what you can steal than whether you can make it out alive.
Stay quiet. Stay out of sight. And whatever you do, don't get eaten.
Explore quaint homes and other locations throughout Sunnybrook. Find your way inside through doors, windows, and other points of entry. Pick locks, crack safes, disable security devices, and steal valuables along the way.
You're a burglar, not a dinosaur hunter. There are no weapons to rely on. Outsmart predators, sneak past them, hide when necessary, and run when there's no other choice.
Explore a community transformed from a peaceful vacation retreat into a prehistoric nightmare. Find a way through the chaos and get out of Sunnybrook alive.

Game Link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4816420/Welcome_to_Sunnybrook/
